name: homework_benchmark
description: homework_benchmark is a collection of homework-style questions and exercises intended to evaluate model performance on typical educational tasks across subjects. It measures the ability of models to solve step-by-step problems, produce correct short answers, and handle curricula-style prompts. The dataset is useful for assessing competence on school- and introductory-college-level assignments.
reputation: Relatively low-profile / community-contributed dataset used mainly for education-oriented evaluations rather than a widely adopted benchmark.
